item.title: How to Read Your Gas Bill: A Plain-English Guide to Every Line Item
item.description: Your gas bill is a stack of charges with confusing names — “distribution charge,” “gas commodity cost,” “customer charge” — and most people pay it without knowing what any of them mean. This guide breaks down every line on a typical gas bill in plain English, starting with what a therm is, then walking through each charge one by one. If you just want the short version, it’s right below.
